summary_1line: Cursed with premature old age, King Yayati asks his sons to exchange their youth; Yadu and Turvasu refuse and receive harsh curses.

image_candidates.scene_text: The suddenly aged King Yayati, hair white and body bent, pleads before his strong young son Yadu to exchange youth for his father’s decrepitude.
Prince Yadu stands firm while the frail, wrinkled Yayati stretches out trembling hands, the royal court watching in tense silence.
Angered by refusal, the aged Yayati raises his hand in curse against his son as courtiers recoil around the throne.
